items.source: lbf - the bean factory
items.translation: lbf - 工厂 Bean

items.source: type - the type of bean to match
items.translation: type - 要匹配的 Bean 类型

items.source: the array of matching bean names, or an empty array if none
items.translation: 匹配的 Bean 名称数组，如果没有则返回空数组。

items.source: Note: Beans of the same name will take precedence at the 'lowest' factory level, i.e. such beans will be returned from the lowest factory that they are being found in, hiding corresponding beans in ancestor factories. This feature allows for 'replacing' beans by explicitly choosing the same bean name in a child factory; the bean in the ancestor factory won't be visible then, not even for by-type lookups.
items.translation: 注意：同名的 Bean 将在“最低”工厂级别优先，即此类 Bean 将从其被发现的最低级工厂返回，从而隐藏祖先工厂中对应的 Bean。此功能允许通过在子工厂中显式选择相同的 Bean 名称来“替换”Bean；此时，祖先工厂中的 Bean 将不可见，即使进行按类型查找也是如此。

items.source:
Does consider objects created by FactoryBeans, which means that FactoryBeans
will get initialized. If the object created by the FactoryBean doesn't match,
the raw FactoryBean itself will be matched against the type.
items.translation: 是否考虑由 FactoryBean 创建的实例，这意味着 FactoryBean 将被初始化。如果由 FactoryBean 创建的实例不匹配类型，则原始 FactoryBean 本身将与该类型进行匹配。

items.source: allowEagerInit - whether to initialize lazy-init singletons and objects created by FactoryBeans (or by factory methods with a "factory-bean" reference) for the type check. Note that FactoryBeans need to be eagerly initialized to determine their type: So be aware that passing in "true" for this flag will initialize FactoryBeans and "factory-bean" references.
items.translation: allowEagerInit - 是否要在类型检查期间初始化懒加载单例和由 FactoryBeans 创建的对象（或由带有“factory-bean"引用的工厂方法创建的对象）。请注意，FactoryBeans 需要被急切初始化以确定其类型：因此，请留意将此标志设置为 "true" 将导致 FactoryBeans 和"factory-bean"引用被初始化。

items.source: includeNonSingletons - whether to include prototype or scoped beans too or just singletons (also applies to FactoryBeans)
items.translation: includeNonSingletons - 是否包含原型或作用域 Bean，还是仅包含单例（同样适用于 FactoryBean）

items.source: the matching bean instance
items.translation: 匹配的 Bean 实例

items.source:
Does consider objects created by FactoryBeans if the "allowEagerInit"
flag is set, which means that FactoryBeans will get initialized. If the
object created by the FactoryBean doesn't match, the raw FactoryBean itself
will be matched against the type. If "allowEagerInit" is not set,
only raw FactoryBeans will be checked (which doesn't require initialization
of each FactoryBean).
items.translation: 如果设置了"allowEagerInit"标志，则考虑由 FactoryBean 创建的对象，这意味着 FactoryBean 将被初始化。如果 FactoryBean 创建的对象不匹配，则将原始 FactoryBean 本身与类型进行匹配。如果未设置"allowEagerInit"，则仅检查原始 FactoryBean（这不需要初始化每个 FactoryBean）。

items.source:
Get all bean names for the given type, including those defined in ancestor
factories.
items.translation: 获取给定类型的所有 Bean 名称，包括在祖先工厂中定义的那些。

items.source: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - if no bean of the given type was found
items.translation: NoSuchBeanDefinitionException - 如果未找到给定类型的 Bean

items.source: NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException - if more than one bean of the given type was found
items.translation: NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException - 如果找到给定类型的多个 Bean

items.source: BeansException - if the bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建该 Bean

items.source: This version of beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors automatically includes prototypes and FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 此版本的 `beanNamesForTypeIncludingAncestors` 会自动包含原型和工厂 Bean。

items.source: type - the type that beans must match (as a ResolvableType)
items.translation: type - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型（作为 ResolvableType）

items.source: name - the name of the bean
items.translation: name - 该 Bean 的名称

items.source: the Map of matching bean instances, or an empty Map if none
items.translation: 匹配 Bean 实例的 Map，如果没有则为空 Map。

items.source: NOTE: It is generally preferable to use ObjectProvider.stream() via BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class) instead of this utility class.
items.translation: 注意： 通常更推荐使用通过BeanFactory.getBeanProvider(Class)调用的ObjectProvider.stream()，而不是此工具类。

items.source: This version of beanOfTypeIncludingAncestors automatically includes prototypes and FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 此版本的 `beanOfTypeIncludingAncestors` 会自动包含原型和 FactoryBean。

items.source: This version of beanOfType automatically includes prototypes and FactoryBeans.
items.translation: 此版本的 `beanOfType` 会自动包含原型和 FactoryBean。

items.source:
Returns bean counts, bean names or bean instances,
taking into account the nesting hierarchy of a bean factory
(which the methods defined on the ListableBeanFactory interface don't,
in contrast to the methods defined on the BeanFactory interface).
items.translation: 返回 Bean 计数、Bean 名称或 Bean 实例，同时考虑 Bean 工厂的嵌套层次结构（与 `BeanFactory` 接口定义的方法不同，`ListableBeanFactory` 接口定义的方法不具备此功能）。

items.source:
Beans that are "overridden" (specified in a descendant factory
with the same name) are only counted once.
items.translation: 被“覆盖”的 Bean（即在后代工厂中指定了相同名称）仅计算一次。

items.source:
Does consider objects created by FactoryBeans if the "allowEagerInit" flag is set,
which means that FactoryBeans will get initialized. If the object created by the
FactoryBean doesn't match, the raw FactoryBean itself will be matched against the
type. If "allowEagerInit" is not set, only raw FactoryBeans will be checked
(which doesn't require initialization of each FactoryBean).
items.translation: 如果设置了"allowEagerInit"标志，则考虑由 FactoryBeans 创建的对象，这意味着 FactoryBeans 将被初始化。如果 FactoryBean 创建的对象不匹配，则将直接对 FactoryBean 本身进行类型匹配。如果未设置"allowEagerInit"，则仅检查原始的 FactoryBeans（这不需要初始化每个 FactoryBean）。

items.source: Get all bean names whose Class has the supplied Annotation type, including those defined in ancestor factories, without creating any bean instances yet. Will return unique names in case of overridden bean definitions.
items.translation: 获取所有其 Class 具有提供的 Annotation类型的 bean 名称，包括在祖先工厂中定义的那些，但不会创建任何 bean 实例。如果存在覆盖的 bean 定义，将返回唯一的名称。

items.source: Return all bean names in the factory, including ancestor factories.
items.translation: 返回工厂中的所有 Bean 名称，包括祖先工厂中的 Bean。

items.source:
Return a single bean of the given type or subtypes, not looking in ancestor
factories.
items.translation: 返回给定类型或其子类型的单个 Bean，不查看祖先工厂。

items.source:
Return a single bean of the given type or subtypes, also picking up beans
defined in ancestor bean factories if the current bean factory is a
HierarchicalBeanFactory.
items.translation: 返回给定类型或其子类型的单个 Bean，如果当前 Bean 工厂是 HierarchicalBeanFactory，还会获取在祖先 Bean 工厂中定义的 Bean。

items.source:
Return all beans of the given type or subtypes, also picking up beans defined in
ancestor bean factories if the current bean factory is a HierarchicalBeanFactory.
items.translation: 返回给定类型或其子类型的所有 Bean，如果当前 Bean 工厂是 `HierarchicalBeanFactory`，还会获取在祖先 Bean 工厂中定义的 Bean。

items.source:
Return whether the given name is a factory dereference
(beginning with the factory dereference prefix).
items.translation: 返回给定的名称是否为工厂解引用（以工厂解引用前缀开头）。

items.source:
Return whether the given name is a bean name which has been generated
by the default naming strategy (containing a "#..." part).
items.translation: 返回给定的名称是否为由默认命名策略生成的 Bean 名称（包含"#"...部分）。

items.source:
Extract the "raw" bean name from the given (potentially generated) bean name,
excluding any "#..." suffixes which might have been added for uniqueness.
items.translation: 从给定的（可能是生成的）bean 名称中提取“原始”bean 名称，排除可能为了唯一性而添加的"#..."后缀。

items.source:
Return the actual bean name, stripping out the factory dereference
prefix (if any, also stripping repeated factory prefixes if found).
items.translation: 返回实际的 Bean 名称，并移除工厂解引用前缀（如果有），同时也会移除重复的工厂前缀。

items.source:
Separator for generated bean names. If a class name or parent name is not
unique, "#1", "#2" etc will be appended, until the name becomes unique.
items.translation: 生成 Bean 名称的分隔符。如果类名或父级名称不唯一，将追加 "#1"、"#2" 等，直到名称变得唯一。

items.source: type - the type that beans must match (as a Class)
items.translation: type - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型（作为 Class）

items.source: BeansException - if a bean could not be created
items.translation: BeansException - 如果无法创建 Bean

items.source: name - the potentially generated bean name
items.translation: name - 可能生成的 Bean 名称

items.source: type - the type that beans must match
items.translation: type - 必须匹配的 Bean 类型

items.source: whether the given name is a factory dereference
items.translation: 给定名称是否为工厂解引用

items.source: the transformed name
items.translation: 转换后的名称

items.source: whether the given name is a generated bean name
items.translation: 给定名称是否为生成的 Bean 名称

items.source: the raw bean name
items.translation: 原始 Bean 名称

items.source: count of beans including those defined in ancestor factories
items.translation: 包含在祖先工厂中定义的 Bean 的总数

items.source: Get all bean names whose Class has the supplied Annotation type, including those defined in ancestor factories, without creating any bean instances yet.
items.translation: 获取所有其 Class 具有提供的 Annotation 类型的 bean 名称，包括在祖先工厂中定义的 bean，且尚未创建任何 bean 实例。

items.source: Separator for generated bean names.
items.translation: 用于生成 Bean 名称的分隔符。

items.source: Count all beans in any hierarchy in which this factory participates.
items.translation: 统计该工厂参与的任意层次结构中的所有 Bean。

items.source: annotationType - the type of annotation to look for
items.translation: annotationType - 要查找的注解类型
